Questions

What is a codeword puzzle?

It looks like a crossword with no clues. Every letter has been swapped for a number from 1 to 26. A few starter letters are given, and you work out the rest from the words they make.

How hard are the puzzles?

There are three levels: 33 easy, 33 medium, 33 hard.

Are the answers included?

Yes. Full solutions are at the back.
